He was extremely courteous and knowledge walking me through the process. The owner, Charles, came out (on time) to give me an estimate, honored his coupon prices and got straight to work. I couldn&#39;t be happier with the work that Charles provided. My carpets look and smell fresh and the tile looks just as good as the day it was installed! He earned my repeat business with his effort and attention to detail. I definitely recommend New Era steam cleaning!</div></div></div><div class="ReviewCard_reviewResponseContainer__wlWlc"><div class="ReviewCard_reviewResponseHeader__fqzX1">Response from <!-- -->New Era pro</div></div><div><div class="ReviewCard_reviewText__g7lgT ReviewCard_reviewTextClamp__eEDhZ" data-testid="review-text">Charles was here within 2 hours of calling at 2am on a Sunday night. We had water throughout 3 rooms of our house. He was able to give use a very detailed estimate and exact game plan for the drying process. He was very detailed in explaining what he was doing and exactly why he was doing it. He even gave us a link to a company called IICRC, who generate the guidelines for water restoration so we could double check and make sure what he was stating was true. He explained the drying could take 3-5 days to be complete, he was done in 3! He was very reasonable on pricing since we decided to pay out of pocket instead of using our insurance. All around great guy, professional and honest. We&#39;ve used him for years for carpet and tile cleaning, hopefully we won&#39;t have to call for water damage again, but he will be the guy we call if it happens!</div></div></div><div class="ReviewCard_reviewResponseContainer__wlWlc"><div class="ReviewCard_reviewResponseHeader__fqzX1">Response from <!-- -->New Era Steam Cleaning &amp; Restoration</div><div class="ShowMore_showMoreBackground__xVomk ReviewCard_showMoreDescription__bWFRI"><div class="ShowMore_showMore__7749_ flex"><blockquote class="ShowMore_comment__aajCs" id="show-more-text-9061" style="display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;-webkit-line-clamp:3">"Thanks for taking the time to give us some feedback!
